blocks.text: THANK YOU FOR SEEING ME, COLONEL. FOR OUR PROGRAMME ON THE FALKLANDS WAR, YOUR ACCOUNT IS INVALUABLE.
ON 2 APRIL 1982, ARGENTINA INVADED THE FALKLANDS. WE HEARD IT ON THE RADIO, LIKE EVERYONE ELSE. THREE DAYS LATER, WE WERE AT SEA.
AND FRANCE? THEY SAY LONDON DIDN'T TRUST PARIS, BECAUSE OF THE EXOCET MISSILES SOLD TO ARGENTINA.
IT'S ALL AT KEW, OLD CHAP. READ MRS THATCHER'S FILES: WE DIDN'T EVEN TRUST OUR FRIENDS.
STATE SECRETS ARE LIKE WINE: THEY NEED THIRTY YEARS.
